---
name: My TV / hardware report
about: Tell us how Glowcast works with your TV, bridge and lights - also when it works fine
title: "Hardware report: <TV model>"
labels: research
---

Thanks for trying Glowcast! Reports from TV models we have not tested are the most useful feedback right now, including "it just works".

**Please leave out personal details:** no room or device names, entity ids, IP addresses or locations. Generic names such as `media_player.living_room_tv` are fine.

## Setup

- **TV model and year:** <!-- for example OLED55C1 (2021). Settings → General → About this TV -->
- **webOS version:** <!-- for example webOS 6.0, firmware 03.40.xx. Same screen -->
- **Hue bridge model:** <!-- Hue Bridge v2 (square) or Hue Bridge Pro -->
- **Lights in the entertainment area:** <!-- optional, for example a gradient lightstrip and two Play bars -->
- **Home Assistant version:** <!-- Settings → About -->
- **Glowcast version:** <!-- HACS, or Settings → Devices & services → Glowcast -->

## Result

- [ ] Works
- [ ] Works partly
- [ ] Does not work

**Captures per second, if known:** <!-- for example "about 3" -->

**DRM / streaming apps tried in the TV's own apps:** <!-- for example "Prime Video: black, lights show the warm glow" or "YouTube: works". Apps on an HDMI stick count separately -->

## What happened

<!-- Free text: what worked, what did not, error messages from the Home Assistant log (with personal details removed), anything that surprised you. -->

## Diagnostics
